about.headline: Results-driven Frontend Developer with 1+ years building production SaaS.
body: I build scalable, responsive SaaS platforms with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 and REST APIs — the kind that real users log into every day, not demos.

So far that has meant production-grade dashboards, helpdesk systems and ERP customizations for international clients, delivering up to 30% faster load times and a 40% reduction in development cycles through reusable, component-based architecture and performance optimization.

experience.summary: Delivering scalable SaaS product interfaces and ERP customizations for international clients across frontend and full-stack integrations.
highlights: Engineered responsive, production-grade UIs for two SaaS platforms (BackupFlex, RaiseATicket) using React.js, JavaScript (ES6+) and Bootstrap, serving 1,000+ end users across web and mobile.
Architected a reusable React component library of 25+ modules, cutting feature development time by ~40% and improving code maintainability across teams.
Optimized rendering and asset delivery, reducing initial page load times by ~30% and lifting Lighthouse performance scores above 90.
Integrated 20+ REST APIs to power real-time dashboards, ticket workflows and authentication flows across pre-login and post-login environments.
Customized Odoo 18 ERP modules (HR, Employee, Sales) and automated workflows via server actions, reducing manual operations by ~25%.
Resolved 50+ production tickets and collaborated with backend and QA teams to ship zero-downtime releases.

projects.name: BackupFlex
projects.summary: Scalable backup-management SaaS with secure authentication and a data-rich product dashboard.
highlights: Built a role-based login system and interactive dashboard in React.js, enabling secure access for 500+ business users.
Implemented reusable UI components for plan management, billing and backup configuration, reducing duplicate code by ~35%.

projects.name: RaiseATicket
projects.summary: Modular SaaS helpdesk focused on real-time ticket workflows and cross-device usability.
highlights: Delivered a modular ticket-management UI in PHP, streamlining agent workflows and improving resolution turnaround.
Enhanced mobile UX with fully responsive layouts, improving mobile engagement by an estimated 25%.
